# Kamptribe Product Truth {#product-truth}

## Product overview {#product-overview}
Kamptribe is a camping road-trip planner for North America. Travellers add campgrounds, national and
provincial parks and stops to a trip, see drive times between stops and share the trip with their
travel group. Trips work on the web and in the iOS and Android apps.

## Tiers {#tiers}
Kamptribe has four tiers: Free, Planner, Advanced and the Trip Pass.
Free covers one active trip with up to ten stops.
Planner adds unlimited trips, offline maps and shared editing.
Advanced adds RV routing with vehicle height and length restrictions and fuel-stop planning.

## Pricing {#pricing}
Free costs nothing. Planner costs 3.99 USD per month or 29.99 USD per year.
Advanced costs 6.99 USD per month or 49.99 USD per year.
The Trip Pass costs 19.99 USD once and unlocks Advanced features for a single trip of up to 30 days.

### Trip Pass {#trip-pass}
A Trip Pass applies to one trip, never renews automatically and can be bought without an account upgrade.

## Does not exist {#not-built}
Kamptribe offers no campground bookings, no live campsite availability and no payments to campgrounds.
